Prototype 2 encodes N2 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (81%), with EOG (14%) and EMG (5%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+5.7 dB, sensitivity=9.1) and elevated σ_h (+2.0 dB, sensitivity=2.9).
The δ activity is present in 69% of each epoch (intermittent), with moderate eye movements (SEM 38% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is coherent with N2 physiology: σ elevated, σ relevant, EOG quiescent — all confirmed.
